description: This file defines the KpiAPI class, an API endpoint for managing KPIs within the OrangeHRM performance module. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, listing, and deleting KPI records, along with associated validation rules and parameters. The class utilizes various traits, models, and external entities related to KPI management.

classes.name: KpiAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing KPI entities, providing CRUD operations, validation, and parameter handling within the OrangeHRM performance plugin.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single KPI by its identifier, returning the KPI data with an editability flag.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all KPIs based on optional search filters, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new KPI record based on provided request body parameters.

methods.name: setKpi
methods.description: Populates a Kpi entity with data from request parameters, used during create and update operations.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getOne' method, ensuring valid ID parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing KPIs, including search filters and sorting.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a KPI.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines common validation rules for KPI data in request bodies.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing KPI record identified by ID, applying data from the request body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for the update operation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more KPIs specified by their IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete operation, primarily validating array of IDs.
